dedupe_keys.name: national gas transmission gas data portal near real time and historical gb gas supply demand flows and capacity

description: The Gas Data Portal of National Gas Transmission, operator of the National Transmission System for gas in Great Britain, provides near real-time data on forecast and live gas supply and demand, flow rates, storage capacity, margins notices, capacity and other operational items. The operator page read on the day of cataloguing states that the portal holds more than 12,000 data items and a suite of predefined reports covering live and historical data, published to reduce market uncertainty and give equal access to information. The same page lists a National Gas app for a near real-time overview of supply and demand, supplementary reports such as demand and composite weather variable forecasts, LNG operator information and linepack, and the Gemini capacity management system used by shippers for capacity trading and balancing. Coverage is the GB gas transmission system. The portal is free to use on the web. Caveats: the portal page itself renders only with JavaScript, so its data terms were not read, and the app is stated to be for information, not decision making. Simulation uses are GB gas network flow and security of supply studies, cold weather demand peaks and gas-electricity coupling. Related records: data-ngn-open-data-portal covers a downstream distribution network, and data-entsog-transparency-platform covers European transmission.
